# Fix f449 ADR citation for unbounded Jira DC reindex support

## Problem
The f449 ticket description still cites "ADR 0037 s3" for the unbounded Jira DC reindex behavior, but ADR 0037 is `oss-contribution-intake-posture`. The support the f449 description meant to cite is the Jira-family sub-seam documentation in `docs/adr/0055-jira-family-sub-seam.md`, specifically the "Search-index lag" row around line 282.

The current `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/snapshot_lagfree_refresh.py` module docstring already cites ADR 0055 rather than ADR 0037; this ticket will make that docstring citation explicit by naming `docs/adr/0055-jira-family-sub-seam.md` / the "Search-index lag" row, while preserving its existing behavior.

## Scope
In scope for this ticket:
- the f449 ticket description text (`f449-be6a-be56-4fef`, alias `seagreen-fortuitous-crayfish`);
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/snapshot_lagfree_refresh.py` module docstring only;
- `docs/adr/0055-jira-family-sub-seam.md` only if the ADR wording itself needs consistency (expected read-only).

Out of scope: other ADR 0037 references in live-harness/test documentation. A repo-wide grep will be reported so any non-f449 stale references are visible, but this bug's fix is limited to the f449-era description/docstring citation.

## Verification plan
- Inspect `docs/adr/0037-oss-contribution-intake-posture.md` to confirm ADR 0037 is the GitHub PR / OSS contribution posture ADR, not Jira DC reindex support.
- Inspect `docs/adr/0055-jira-family-sub-seam.md` around the "Search-index lag" row to confirm the correct Jira-family sub-seam citation target.
- Run `grep -nE 'ADR 0037|0037 s3|oss-contribution-intake-posture|ADR 0055|0055-jira-family-sub-seam' src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/snapshot_lagfree_refresh.py` and inspect the f449 description to prove the in-scope stale citation is gone and the replacement citation points to ADR 0055 / the ADR 0055 path.
- Run the project verification commands (`make lint && make typecheck && make test`) after the docstring-only code change.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The f449 ticket description no longer points readers to ADR 0037 / `oss-contribution-intake-posture` for Jira DC reindex behavior; it points to ADR 0055 / `docs/adr/0055-jira-family-sub-seam.md` instead.
- [ ] `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/snapshot_lagfree_refresh.py` cites `docs/adr/0055-jira-family-sub-seam.md` or ADR 0055 for the Jira-family sub-seam/search-index-lag support, and contains no `ADR 0037` / `0037 s3` Jira-DC-reindex citation.
- [ ] A repo-wide grep for `ADR 0037` / `0037 s3` near `reindex`, `Jira DC`, `Lucene`, or `unbounded` is recorded, with in-scope hits fixed here and any out-of-scope hits explicitly reported.
- [ ] Project verification is green with the worktree virtualenv first on `PATH`.
